nodes.label: Exactly one conversation draft and exact POST confirmation
nodes.author: Ang Jing Kang
nodes.norm_label: exactly one conversation draft and exact post confirmation
nodes.rationale: Collect one group, nonempty caption and local images or explicit NO IMAGES; default to dry-run, keep exactly one pending draft and allow one live worker execution only after exact POST with --confirm true.

nodes.label: Atomic JSON draft store and approved groups
nodes.norm_label: atomic json draft store and approved groups

nodes.label: Webhook verification and HMAC signature validation
nodes.norm_label: webhook verification and hmac signature validation

nodes.label: Draft-bound expiring confirmation token
nodes.rationale: POST requires one unchanged dry_run_ready draft, screenshot, unexpired token, and matching user and conversation; edits invalidate confirmation.

nodes.label: Manual browser recovery without live retries
nodes.norm_label: manual browser recovery without live retries
nodes.rationale: Preserve failure screenshots, inspect failed or unknown results manually and resolve login, checkpoint, CAPTCHA, 2FA or action blocks in the local browser without bypasses or automatic live retries.

nodes.label: Graph-first codebase navigation
nodes.rationale: Scoped graph queries locate relevant files and relationships before source browsing; code changes require graph updates.

nodes.label: Dry-run gated POST and CANCEL
nodes.rationale: Live posting requires a valid dry-run, screenshot, unexpired confirmation token and explicit approval; CANCEL never calls the live worker and failed live posts are never retried automatically.

nodes.label: Local media download and token isolation
nodes.norm_label: local media download and token isolation
nodes.rationale: Resolve media metadata and download binaries with bearer authorization, then retain only local paths and media IDs in drafts; reject remote worker image URLs and exclude tokens, temporary URLs and browser sessions.

nodes.label: Local Facebook posting boundary
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp is the control surface; Facebook automation remains on the local machine through the draft manager, worker, OpenCLI plugin and Browser Bridge, keeping browser sessions local.

nodes.label: Mode A local HTTPS tunnel MVP
nodes.norm_label: mode a local https tunnel mvp
nodes.rationale: Run the control server on the awake office or laptop machine behind an HTTPS tunnel for the simplest trust boundary; cloud relay Mode B is future documentation only.
